# Splice Bots: agent reference

> What an agent needs to work on this realm at this build: its wire and pins, content tables, shapes, limits, the driver's operations and the diagnostic codes. Generated by `coax/web/agent-reference.coax` from the sources named below; never edited by hand. It describes the build it is served beside, not `main`.

The site's index is [llms.txt](https://openagents.com/llms.txt). Look a Coax name up with `coax vocab NAME`.

## Build

- realm: splice-bots
- page: `/worlds/splice-bots` (module `splice-bots`, source `apps/openagents-web/realms/splice-bots/`)
- wire: none. The page decides the simulation; there is no room to speak to
- content: `metaverse/splice-bots/content/splice.content`, revision 4, sha256 `7a0244fa5b57c6a33df4daae77971151ec9a42b4d0808459b57d2ad25e6ab82a`
- diagnostics: `engine-diagnostics-v1`, 17 codes, sha256 `55aa5a9b50ff02e1256e64909abf901a29f9c98a1575ae6b669281410b69c31c` (`proto/verse/engine-diagnostics-v1.json`)
- language: Coax; the compiler's version is in `coax/release-status.json` and what it claims to do in `coax/book/capability-claims.json`
- reference: the last line of this file is the sha256 of everything above it. Two builds with the same line have the same reference

## State and authority

From `metaverse-engine/editor/authority.coax` (INVARIANTS.md, "Authoring never writes durable state").

- content, who may change what is authored: owner-admins
- simulation, what decides what is running: page
- durability, what holds what outlives a session: none

| Operation | May write |
| --- | --- |
| edit | authored, running |
| undo | authored, running |
| redo | authored, running |
| content-rollback | authored, running |
| world-save | authored |
| world-load | authored, running |
| publish | authored |
| code-reload | running |
| sim-step | running |
| ledger | nothing in this realm |
| character | nothing in this realm |

## Content tables

- format: `aethyr.content.v1` (docs/protocol/aethyr-content-v1.md): one text document; a `table NAME COLUMNS` line, then a row a line, cells split by `|`
- document: splice
- revision: 4
- reach, cm: 60000

| Table | Columns | Rows |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `actors` | `id name:text` | 9 |
| `areas` | `id name:text x:cm z:cm hx:int hz:int r:int` | 7 |
| `beats` | `id area:int from:text to:text` | 1 |
| `board` | `id on:text casual:int fast:int` | 1 |
| `clock` | `id when:text` | 1 |
| `credits` | `id line:text` | 5 |
| `dolly` | `id x:cm y:cm z:cm ax:cm ay:cm az:cm secs:int` | 3 |
| `kept_clear` | `id name:text x:cm z:cm hx:int hz:int r:int` | 31 |
| `landmarks` | `id name:text x:cm z:cm r:int` | 57 |
| `looks` | `id name:text a:int b:int c:int` | 9 |
| `menu` | `id key:text label:text` | 3 |
| `pieces` | `id name:text kit:text scale:int look:ref.looks hx:int hz:int top:int` | 27 |
| `plans` | `id who:int when:text do:text route:text speed:int notice:int on:text` | 36 |
| `portals` | `id name:text from:text to:text yaw:int r:int` | 3 |
| `scripts` | `id name:text hash:text for:text` | 0 |
| `starts` | `id when:text at:text yaw:int` | 1 |
| `templates` | `id name:text parts:text` | 0 |

A table's first column is `id`. Another column is `NAME:int`, `NAME:text`, `NAME:cm` (centimetres), `NAME:ref.TABLE` (the id of a row of TABLE) or `NAME:opt.TABLE` (the same, or 0 for none). A row's id is never changed or used again.

## Wire and stored shapes

The rows of `proto/registry.json` whose codec or files are this realm's (under `metaverse/splice-bots/`, `metaverse-engine/content/`, `metaverse-engine/editor/edit.coax`, `metaverse-engine/editor/doc.coax`, `metaverse-engine/agent/`). Each has one codec file; read a shape through it and never write its bytes by hand (proto/README.md).

| Id | Kind | Owner | Schema |

| `world.asset.upload.v1` | profile | realm-authoring | `proto/world/assets-v1.json` |
| `world.card.v1` | profile | coder | `proto/world/card-v1.json` |
| `realm-document-v1` | proto | realm-authoring | `proto/openagents/verse/doc/v1alpha1/realm.proto#RealmDocument` |

## Limits

Every limit is shown here and none is hidden. Past one, the engine refuses or drops the work and says so: ask `why caps`.

| Limit | Value | Where |
| --- | --- | --- |
| entities in the World of colliders, placed pieces among them | 256 | `SL_CAP` in `metaverse/splice-bots/layer.coax` |
| placed pieces the edit layer holds | 64 | `SL_ITEMS` in `metaverse/splice-bots/layer.coax` |
| steps the edit layer's undo keeps | 64 | `SL_STEPS` in `metaverse/splice-bots/layer.coax` |
| entities one collision question looks at | 64 | `SL_NEAR` in `metaverse/splice-bots/layer.coax` |
| kinds of piece in the pieces table | 32 | `SC_PIECE_MAX` in `metaverse/splice-bots/content.coax` |
| bytes in a content document | 65536 | `CT_BODY` in `metaverse-engine/content/tables.coax` |
| tables in a content document | 24 | `CT_TABLES` in `metaverse-engine/content/tables.coax` |
| columns in a table, its id among them | 8 | `CT_COLS` in `metaverse-engine/content/tables.coax` |
| rows in a content document | 1024 | `CT_ROWS` in `metaverse-engine/content/tables.coax` |
| bytes in a document's, a table's or a column's name | 15 | `CT_NAME` in `metaverse-engine/content/tables.coax` |
| entities the driver's tree lists in a frame | 128 | `DRV_ENTS` in `metaverse-engine/agent/drive.coax` |
| HUD widgets the layout trace keeps in a frame | 768 | `UIT_MAX` in `metaverse-engine/ui/trace.coax` |

## Operations

`coax/web/tool.sh drive web apps/openagents-web /worlds/splice-bots OP...` drives the page in headless Chrome, one operation an argument (coax/start-here.md).

| Operation | What it answers |
| --- | --- |
| `tree`, `layout` | What is in the world and on the HUD, by stable id |
| `state PATH` | A field of the realm's state |
| `why ID`, `why caps` | Why a thing isn't seen, reached or working; the limits applied this run |
| `hit X Y`, `taps` | What receives a tap at a point; tap targets that are small, covered or overlapping |
| `tap ID`, `type ID TEXT` | A click on a widget; typing into it |
| `walk-to ID` and the other world operations | Refused by name: this realm takes none from a driver yet |
| `clock +MS`, `clock settle`, `clock until PATH` | Steps the agent clock |
| `screenshot FILE`, `logs`, `perf` | The page as it is, its console, its frame counters |

## Editing the world

`openagents realm VERB splice-bots ...` edits the world on its dev lane (docs/protocol/world-edit-v1.md). Each write is one step that `world-undo` takes back, and the server checks it and answers a refusal in words. `--origin http://127.0.0.1:PORT` sends it to `coax serve` on this computer. The same rows are the `realm_*` MCP tools (`realm_world_plan` is `world-plan`). From `apps/openagents-cli/commands.coax`:

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `openagents realm world-switch ID ROW on\|off [--rev N] [--dry-run] [--key K] [--shot OUT.png]` | turn a realm's board row ROW (its key, as realm world lists the rows table) on or off: a cell edit, one undo step |
| `openagents realm world-tools ID --tools build,fly,jump,map,talk,voice [--rev N] [--dry-run] [--key K] [--shot OUT.png]` | the tools a realm's visitors get: those named are on, the rest of its tools table off; cell edits, one undo step |
| `openagents realm world ID [--lane dev\|live]` | a world with an ID, as you need it to aim an edit: its revision and build, its placed things by number, its content tables (pieces, landmarks, kept-clear zones) and its reference page |
| `openagents realm world-place ID KIND X Z [--yaw DEG] [--rev N] [--dry-run] [--key K] [--shot OUT.png]` | place a thing of content ID KIND at X Z centimetres; the answer has its number, the new revision, and any refusal in words |
| `openagents realm world-move ID N X Z [--rev N] [--dry-run] [--key K] [--shot OUT.png]` | move placed thing N to X Z centimetres |
| `openagents realm world-turn ID N DEGREES [--rev N] [--dry-run] [--key K] [--shot OUT.png]` | turn placed thing N to DEGREES |
| `openagents realm world-set ID N COLUMN VALUE [--rev N] [--dry-run] [--key K] [--shot OUT.png]` | set a column of thing N: x, y, z in centimetres, yaw in degrees, or another column the world takes |
| `openagents realm world-remove ID N [--rev N] [--dry-run] [--key K] [--shot OUT.png]` | remove placed thing N (world-undo brings it back) |
| `openagents realm world-undo ID [--rev N] [--dry-run] [--key K] [--shot OUT.png]` | take back the newest step that stands, whoever made it |
| `openagents realm world-redo ID [--rev N] [--dry-run] [--key K] [--shot OUT.png]` | take the step last undone again |
| `openagents realm world-original ID [--rev N] [--dry-run] [--key K] [--shot OUT.png]` | remove every placed thing: the designed world again (world-undo brings them back) |
| `openagents realm world-apply ID FILE.jsonl [--rev N] [--dry-run] [--key K] [--shot OUT.png]` | apply world.edit.v1 edits, a JSON object a line, as one batch: all are saved or none |
| `openagents realm world-publish ID now\|next [--rev N] [--confirm HASH[,HASH]] [--key K] [--yes]` | make the dev revision live: for open sessions now, or from each person's next session; a script that is new or does more than the live one needs its hash in --confirm, and a publish without it answers what each adds and the command that confirms them |
| `openagents realm world-why ID THING` | why a thing (you, piece-N, ...) is not seen, reached or working: the first link that failed, from the world's page |
| `openagents realm world-open ID` | the address of the page that edits the world |
| `openagents realm world-foes ID [--lane dev\|live]` | the world's actors by number and name, each one's plan at dawn, day, dusk and night (what it does, its route, speed, notice range and what it does on noticing), the editor's time of day, and the places a route may name |
| `openagents realm world-plan ID FOE WHEN DO [--route "X Z, X Z"] [--speed CM/S] [--notice CM] [--on chase\|call\|flee\|ignore] [--rev N] [--dry-run] [--key K] [--shot OUT.png]` | set what actor FOE does at WHEN (dawn, day, dusk, night): stand, dance, sleep, guard, patrol, wander or follow; without --route its route is cut or grown to fit; one edit, one undo step |
| `openagents realm world-route ID FOE WHEN "X Z, X Z" [--rev N] [--dry-run] [--key K] [--shot OUT.png]` | set actor FOE's route at WHEN: X Z points in centimetres joined by commas (patrol 2 to 8, a loop ends where it starts; guard the post then where it looks; wander "X Z R"; follow "foe N") |
| `openagents realm world-time ID story\|dawn\|day\|dusk\|night [--rev N] [--dry-run] [--key K] [--shot OUT.png]` | the editor's time of day: the actors keep it and the light is it (story: the run's own clock); play is not changed |
| `openagents realm world-board ID on\|off [--casual CM/S] [--fast CM/S] [--rev N] [--dry-run] [--key K] [--shot OUT.png]` | give the player a hoverboard or take it away, with its casual and very fast speeds in centimetres a second (100 to 6000; the fast one faster); what you leave out stays; one edit, one undo step |
| `openagents realm world-scripts ID` | the world's stored realm scripts, one a line: name, hash, bytes, handlers, what it may do and call, whether it is switched off and whether its source is kept; then the limits |
| `openagents realm world-script-compile ID FILE.coax --name NAME [--dry-run] [--key K]` | send a realm script's Coax source to be compiled, checked and stored; the answer is the stored script's hash and what it may do, or the compiler's words |
| `openagents realm world-script-put ID FILE.wasm --name NAME [--fields NAME.json] [--dry-run] [--key K]` | store a built script module (coax/web/script.sh writes NAME.wasm and NAME.json; --fields NAME.json keeps its state across a swap); the answer is its hash and what it may do |
| `openagents realm world-script-run ID --script HASH --name NAME --for "kind K"\|"who N" [--place N] [--rev N] [--dry-run] [--key K] [--shot OUT.png]` | run a stored script: a row of the world's scripts table names its hash and what it drives, every thing of kind K or actor N; --place is the row, 1 to 8 (by default the row of that name, else the first free one); one edit, one undo step |
| `openagents realm world-script-report ID HASH --why "WORDS" [--yes]` | report a stored script to the site's admins with a short reason; they keep it or switch it off everywhere |

## The realm's code

The realm's code is the Coax under `metaverse/splice-bots/`: the module `metaverse/splice-bots/splice-bots.coax` and the files it loads, and its GPU code under `metaverse/splice-bots/gpu/`. On the dev server (`coax serve`), saving one of them builds the module again and swaps the engine in every open page: the world, its placed things and its tables stay. A build that fails keeps the last good engine running. `coax/bin/coax check metaverse/splice-bots/splice-bots.coax` prints the compiler's words for it, and `coax/bin/coax test metaverse/splice-bots/splice-bots.coax` runs its checks. A deployed page takes no code: there, every change is a world command above.

## Diagnostic codes

`why ID` answers with the first failed link of state, spawned, view, drawn, asset, collider, system (docs/metaverse/diagnostics.md).

| Number | Code | Id | Link | Retry |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | `not-in-state` | `engine.diagnostic.not-in-state.v1` | state | no |
| 2 | `spawn-pending` | `engine.diagnostic.spawn-pending.v1` | spawned | yes |
| 3 | `spawn-refused` | `engine.diagnostic.spawn-refused.v1` | spawned | no |
| 4 | `despawned` | `engine.diagnostic.despawned.v1` | spawned | no |
| 5 | `not-in-view` | `engine.diagnostic.not-in-view.v1` | view | no |
| 6 | `draw-pending` | `engine.diagnostic.draw-pending.v1` | drawn | yes |
| 7 | `draw-dropped` | `engine.diagnostic.draw-dropped.v1` | drawn | no |
| 8 | `draw-hidden` | `engine.diagnostic.draw-hidden.v1` | drawn | no |
| 9 | `asset-loading` | `engine.diagnostic.asset-loading.v1` | asset | yes |
| 10 | `asset-failed` | `engine.diagnostic.asset-failed.v1` | asset | no |
| 11 | `asset-missing` | `engine.diagnostic.asset-missing.v1` | asset | no |
| 12 | `collider-missing` | `engine.diagnostic.collider-missing.v1` | collider | no |
| 13 | `collider-open` | `engine.diagnostic.collider-open.v1` | collider | no |
| 14 | `system-pending` | `engine.diagnostic.system-pending.v1` | system | yes |
| 15 | `system-paused` | `engine.diagnostic.system-paused.v1` | system | no |
| 16 | `budget-hit` | `engine.diagnostic.budget-hit.v1` | runtime | no |
| 17 | `pack-refused` | `engine.diagnostic.pack-refused.v1` | runtime | no |

## Examples

Ask what is there, then why one thing isn't:

```sh
coax/web/tool.sh drive web apps/openagents-web /worlds/splice-bots "tree" "why you" "why caps" "taps"
```

An answer:

```text
why you: not-in-view
code: engine.diagnostic.not-in-view.v1
link: view (3 of 7)
field: camera.frame
expected: inside the frame
actual: past its right edge
retry: no
passed: state spawned
```

A content row, under its table's line:

```text
table actors id name:text
1|Raider 1
```

reference sha256: 6e0141d861d6d5254a3f95e3d56b34a5ad787e4fdaf34a22a262e23f55f1b241
